idea-plugin.name: Run Claude Code Cmd Any Where
idea-plugin.description:
Run Claude Code CLI commands in any directory with a right-click menu, and generate AI commit messages.

  • Right-click on any directory/file in Project View to run commands
  • Customizable command presets in Settings → Tools → Run Claude Code Cmd Settings
  • Support multiple execution modes: IDE Terminal or External Terminal window
  • Default command: "Run Claude Here" with claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions

AI Git Commit

Generate Git commit messages with AI based on your code changes. Supports DeepSeek, Gemini, SiliconFlow, Ollama, OpenAI API, Cloudflare Workers AI, 阿里云百炼, 火山引擎, OpenRouter, Kimi and OpenAI-compatible LLMs.

  • Select the code you want to commit and click "Generate AI Commit Message".
  • The generated commit message is filled into the commit message editor.
  • Configurable custom prompts in Settings → Tools → AI Git Commit.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added AI Git Commit capability (merged from HMYDK/AIGitCommit, AGPL-3.0):

  • Generate AI commit messages from staged/selected changes via the Commit dialog
  • Multiple LLM providers: DeepSeek, Gemini, SiliconFlow, Ollama, OpenAI, Cloudflare, 阿里云百炼, 火山引擎, OpenRouter, Kimi, OpenAI-compatible
  • Project-level & custom prompts, file exclusion rules
  • Respect partial commit selection; trim oversized AI inputs

Initial release:

  • Right-click menu integration in Project View
  • Customizable command presets with displayName, command, shellType, executeMode
  • Support Terminal (IDE built-in) and Dialog (external terminal) execution modes
  • Auto shell detection for Windows/Mac/Linux
